verdict.rationale: HMRC runs its own live, versioned production REST API platform for Making Tax Digital, and its docs say submissions go through compatible software, so programmatic, non-UI operation is a first-party channel. However, the evidence never documents headless or CI use, the auth model for unattended runs, or a CLI. The developer documentation is blocked to crawlers, so the depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI workflow, non-interactive auth or credentials for automation, accessible API docs, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end automated run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: a live, versioned production REST platform (Making Tax Digital) answering with a structured error contract, an auth/header model rather than a bot wall
You’ll need to use software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax to send any missed quarterly updates for the year so far.
